neighbours.label: narrative about Tolkien's Middle-earth characters (fires on the function words between their names and actions)
fire: After the battle, Legolas and Gimli rode together toward Helm's Deep.
Elrond called the council, and Boromir argued that the Ring should be used.
Sam carried Frodo up the slopes of Mount Doom when he could no longer walk.
Saruman betrayed the White Council and allied himself with Sauron.
Galadriel gave each member of the Fellowship a gift before they left Lothlórien.
In the First Age, Beren and Lúthien recovered a Silmaril from Morgoth's crown.
Merry and Pippin escaped from the orcs and fled into Fangorn Forest.
Théoden rode out with the Rohirrim to break the siege of Minas Tirith.
quiet: After the battle, Wellington and Blücher rode together toward Brussels.
Churchill called the cabinet, and Halifax argued that peace talks should be tried.
The guide carried the climber down the slopes of Everest when he could no longer walk.
Brutus betrayed the Roman Senate and allied himself with Cassius.
The queen gave each member of the expedition a gift before they left London.
In the Middle Ages, Abelard and Heloise exchanged letters from their monasteries.
Two prisoners escaped from the guards and fled into the Black Forest.
Napoleon rode out with the Old Guard to break the siege of Dresden.
